question: Kerala is famous for which of the following festivals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Onam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Onam:-**

 
 
• It is the most popular festival celebrated in the state of Kerala, India.
 
• It is a 10-day harvest festival that usually falls in the month of August or September.
 
• The festival is marked by various cultural events and traditional activities such as boat races, flower decorations, and feasting.
 
• Onam is celebrated to honor the legendary king Mahabali and to welcome his annual visit to Kerala. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pongal:-**

 
 
• It is a harvest festival celebrated in Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana.
 
 
 
• **Ugadi:-**
 
 
• It is a New Year festival celebrated in the states of Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, and Karnataka.
 
 
 
• **Bihu:-**
 
 
• It is a harvest festival celebrated in the state of Assam.
